explains: Two files change: src/contest/engine.ts and src/components/__tests__/StatusBadge.test.tsx. The test markers are matched per path segment (the folder __tests__/ and the file name parts .test. and .spec.), never as a substring: the path src/contest/engine.ts contains the characters test/ inside the segment contest, but its segments are src, contest and engine.ts, none of which is a test marker, so it is a source file. src/components/__tests__/StatusBadge.test.tsx has the segment __tests__ and the name part .test., so it is a test file. engine.ts is imported by no file, so no screen is reached. The test file imports StatusBadge but nothing imports the test.

must_exclude.why: contest/ is not a test folder: the marker test/ must match a whole path segment
